verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a URL-to-markdown scraping API. A scraping service could plausibly expose a browser endpoint that Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium or Scrapy connect to, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that Reader runs headless Chrome internally and accepts header options such as engine choice and wait-for-selector. Nothing shows developers can drive it with, or plug it into, open-source automation libraries.
